tldr: Mars through the 6th house heats up work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Mars moves through your 6th house, it adds heat and urgency to work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
